subject: Titan Health — request for extended pilot window and additional complimentary credits
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@titanhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot extension & credits — Titan Health

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's inference performance on our HL7 ingestion and redaction flows. We have one ask from procurement and engineering before we can commit to a FY27 POC: can Redwood extend the pilot window beyond the standard PLG sandbox and add complimentary credits to cover a regulated-environment validation run?

Current PLG baseline: 30 days, 500k token quota. Our needs: 90 days and roughly $15k in platform credits (to run full-scale redaction + end-to-end latency tests across 3 clinical sites). Procurement attached a short requirements list for contract/PO processing.

This is a strategic evaluation for Titan Health — if the validation passes, we plan to pilot Redwood in our production staging in Q1 and pursue a committed Dedicated contract. Can you advise whether Redwood can approve a one-off extension + credit uplift or whether we should pursue a paid sandbox add-on?

Appreciate a quick read — procurement has a target decision by 11/22.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director of Platform Integrations
Titan Health
Attachments: titan_po_requirements.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@titanhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & credits — Titan Health

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the requirements. We're encouraged this is moving toward a deeper technical validation.

Quick notes for transparency: PLG policy covers a 30-day sandbox with a small complimentary token allotment intended for evaluation. One-off extensions and free credit top-ups do require commercial/deal-desk approval when they exceed PLG thresholds. Given Titan's potential scale and the regulated nature of the integration, I believe this is a case to seek executive review.

Requesting approval from leadership on whether we can:
- Extend sandbox from 30 -> 90 days
- Provide $15,000 in complimentary credits (to be consumed only within the pilot environment)
- Allow customer-managed logging redaction checklist to be signed-off by security if needed

Context / To help the decision:
- Titan has a ~1k seat clinical network; projected Dedicated spend if successful: $120k+/yr
- Engineering needs are time-sensitive due to Q1 go/no-go gating
- Procurement prefers a single PO (we can accept a nominal pilot addendum)

Jonas — looping you in for commercial view; I can draft a short one-off amendment (attaching a working terms doc) and coordinate with Legal/Finance. If you need further detail, happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Strategic Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_pilot_terms_draft_v2.docx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & credits — Titan Health

Naomi — thanks for flagging and for the draft terms. I support making an exception here but want guardrails:

Proposed approval (subject to final Legal/Finance sign-off):
- 60 additional days (total 90 days) — approved
- Complimentary credits: up to $12,000 of platform credits (split: $8k for inference tokens, $4k for embeddings/ingestion) — approved as an accelerated concession
- Approval conditional on: signed pilot addendum, acceptance of standard usage telemetry for quality/regression monitoring, and a firm commitment to a procurement decision meeting by 2027-02-01.

Rationale: Titan's integration represents a high-conversion profile (regulated health vertical, clear path to Dedicated, multiple internal sponsors). The ask for $15k is modest but hits PLG thresholds; we should mitigate by slightly lowering the funded amount and adding firm decision-date commitments.

Aditya — please confirm financial authority for the adjusted credit amount or escalate to revenue leadership if needed. Marissa, please prepare the deal record and HQ approval memo for Legal/Finance.

-Jonas
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension & credits — Titan Health

Thanks team — I've reviewed the context and authorize the concession with the guardrails Jonas proposed. Final notes:
- Approve $12,000 in complimentary credits and 60 additional days to reach 90 days total.
- Legal to finalize a short pilot addendum that includes: consumption boundaries, telemetry acceptance, and a statement of intent with a provisional procurement decision date (2027-02-01).
- Finance to flag that any overage beyond the $12k will be billable at standard PLG rates; include a simple invoicing path if Titan wants to pre-pay for the delta.

Naomi — you can communicate the approved concession to Titan and attach the pilot addendum once Legal signs off. Please update the HubSpot deal (link in metadata) and tag me and Jonas on the record.

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
